question: Rearrange the sentences P, Q, R, S to form a meaningful paragraph: P. Online shopping has changed the way people buy goods. Q. Many of them have therefore started selling through websites too. R. However, small shopkeepers have found it hard to compete. S. Customers can now compare prices without leaving their homes.
explanation: The opener and connectors fix this order.
